name: New topic request

title: "[Topic Request] "

---

## Topic

What mathematical topic or concept would you like to see covered?

## Suggested module

Which existing module does this fit into (e.g. `01_Linear_Algebra`), or does it need a new
module? If you're not sure, that's fine — just describe the topic.

## Why it matters for AI/ML/LLMs

What's the concrete connection to AI, machine learning, or LLM systems? (This becomes the
"Why This Matters for AI" section of the notebook.)

## Suggested prerequisites

Which existing notebooks would a learner need to understand first?

## Additional context

Links to papers, textbook sections, or existing explanations that might help whoever writes
this notebook. Add anything else that's useful here.
